halt_handoff.text:
Loop 3 ended at HALT_STAGNATION (subtype: no_backlog).

What this means: All three Noticeable-weakness findings are resolved (F-001 L1, F-002 L2, F-003 L3). The only remaining finding (F-004, Hero device mockup) is Cosmetic for contest — accepted residual, not backlog. The test_strategy score (3/10) has a named framework-constrained blocker: static site with no runtime domain logic; adding unit tests would be ceremony without assertion targets. No further structural improvement is available without adding infrastructure the site genuinely does not need.

Current scorecard:
  Architecture quality: 9.5 (accepted residual: Hero.astro mockup, cosmetic)
  State management: 10
  Concurrency: 10
  Test strategy: 3 (framework-constrained; static site; no runtime logic)
  Implementation credibility: 9.5 (accepted residual: Hero.astro tile drift, cosmetic)
  Domain modeling: 9.5 (accepted residual: Hero.astro tile labels, cosmetic)
  Data flow: 9.5 (accepted residual: Hero.astro cosmetic, not data flow)
  Framework idioms: 9.5 (accepted residual: Hero.astro mockup as inline HTML vs component, cosmetic)
  Code simplicity: 9.5 (accepted residual: Hero.astro 220-line mockup, cosmetic)

Next step options:
  (a) Accept the halt — the codebase is structurally clean for a static Astro site. Remaining items are cosmetic or framework-constrained. Contest standing: solid Good.
  (b) Inspect the Hero mockup manually — read src/components/Hero.astro and decide whether to replace the device mockup with a real screenshot or source tile labels from site.ts. Then re-invoke /contest-refactor if you want another loop.
  (c) Scope down and target Hero.astro — re-invoke as '/contest-refactor --scope src/components/Hero.astro' if you want F-004 addressed as a targeted refactor.
  (d) Reset and try a different angle — '/contest-refactor --reset' archives this halt and starts fresh from current source.

expected_actions.description: User accepts current halt; no commits expected
Replace Hero.astro device mockup with screenshot or source tile labels from site.ts
User resets and starts fresh from current source

verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet
verdict_explanation: Three loops resolved all Noticeable-weakness findings: Schema.org honesty leak (L1), parallel icons array drift (L2), and BASE_URL scatter across 7 files (L3). Architecture is a clean flat DAG with a single content source and single URL-construction helper. Remaining items are cosmetic (Hero.astro mockup) or framework-constrained (test_strategy:3 for a static site with no runtime domain logic).

architecture_quality.proof: L3 commit extracts src/utils/url.ts — deletion test passes (9 callers; removing helper brings complexity back); no pass-through wrappers; flat DAG; all Seams honest. Terminal normalization: Hero.astro device mockup is cosmetic residual.
architecture_quality.residual_blocking_10: Hero.astro:28-63 device mockup (220 lines hardcoded) — cosmetic; deletion test passes, earns its keep as above-fold visual
architecture_quality.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Cosmetic for contest; deletion test passes (complexity does not redistribute); earns its keep as above-fold hero visual; not a structural ownership issue.

state_management.proof: src/content/site.ts — as const literal; zero mutable runtime state. Static site generator with no writers, readers, or persistence seam. 10-anchor: no behavior-preserving improvement available.

concurrency.proof: No async/await, no Promise, no event handlers. Astro SSG builds synchronous template trees at build time. Concurrency genuinely N/A for static site. 10-anchor: no concurrency exists to improve.

test_strategy.proof: Zero test files in repo; astro check provides type correctness only. 9-anchor (tests targeting real Interfaces) not met — static site with no runtime domain logic. Named blocker: no behavioral domain logic to test; template output deterministic from typed data; SPT fails on 'does it fix real ambiguity?'. Framework-constrained; not a valid backlog item.

credibility.proof: L3 commit resolves URL double-slash hazard — previously bare ${BASE_URL}path was accidentally correct only because literals lacked leading slashes; url('/support') now always normalizes. Terminal normalization: Hero.astro tile drift is cosmetic.
credibility.residual_blocking_10: Hero.astro:28-63 hardcoded tile labels — cosmetic presentation drift, not a data honesty failure
credibility.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Cosmetic for contest; tile labels are decorative mockup data, not architectural honesty leak.

domain_modeling.proof: L2 commit moved benefit icons into site.ts — domain model for all content now complete, TypeScript enforces presence. Terminal normalization (this loop's Residual Accounting Pass): Hero.astro tile labels are presentation mockup, not domain model data; 9-anchor met (types prove invariants by construction).
domain_modeling.residual_blocking_10: Hero.astro:28-63 tile labels hardcoded — cosmetic simulation, not domain model data
domain_modeling.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Cosmetic for contest; hero visual is decorative presentation, not domain data. site.ts domain model is complete and TypeScript-enforced.

data_flow.proof: L3 commit — import.meta.env.BASE_URL now owned by exactly one symbol (url() in src/utils/url.ts); grep -r 'import.meta.env.BASE_URL' src/ returns only the definition at url.ts:13. DAG: all components import only from ../content/site and ../utils/url.
data_flow.residual_blocking_10: No remaining data flow residual — Hero.astro presentation labels not a data flow concern
data_flow.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Hero.astro tile labels are cosmetic presentation, not a data flow ownership issue. No data flow residual can be named beyond this.

framework_idioms.proof: L3 resolves the blocker explicitly named in L2 scorecard ('BASE_URL construction without a shared url() helper — a non-idiomatic pattern duplicated across 7 files'). Now idiomatic: one helper, consistent callers. Fragment set:html for SVGs (L2), is:inline for Schema.org (L1), typed interface Props in components.
framework_idioms.residual_blocking_10: Hero.astro:28-63 device mockup as inline HTML — could be a <DeviceMockup /> Astro component; cosmetic
framework_idioms.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Cosmetic for contest; componentizing the mockup adds ceremony without fixing an ownership issue or improving Locality meaningfully.

simplicity.proof: L3 removes 9 inline regex-strip or bare-concat expressions across 7 files; callers read url('/support'). Net: 7 files simpler, one helper owns the pattern. Deletion test passes (9 callers would re-implement if removed).
simplicity.residual_blocking_10: Hero.astro:28-63 220 lines of hardcoded device mockup HTML/CSS — cosmetic
simplicity.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Cosmetic for contest; earns its keep as above-fold visual; deletion test passes.

strengths: All Noticeable-weakness findings resolved across 3 loops: F-001 (Schema.org honesty), F-002 (parallel array drift), F-003 (BASE_URL scatter) — three concrete structural improvements, no ceremony added
Single URL convention: url(path) in src/utils/url.ts owns all BASE_URL construction; deletion test passes (9 callers would re-implement if removed)
Genuine content centralization: site.ts as const, all domain copy including benefit icons; adding a benefit without an icon field is a TypeScript compile error

findings.title: BASE_URL construction repeated at 9 call sites across 7 files with inconsistent patterns
findings.why_it_matters: Any URL convention change requires touching 7 files with two inconsistent patterns that can produce broken links on GitHub Pages.
findings.what_is_wrong: Two construction patterns: (1) ${BASE_URL}${link.href.replace(/^\//, '')} in SiteHeader.astro:19,33; (2) bare ${BASE_URL}support in SiteFooter.astro:10-12, FAQList.astro:33, support.astro:71-73. Pattern 2 works only because literals happen not to have leading slashes; adding a leading slash would produce double-slash on GitHub Pages.
findings.leverage_impact: Each call site previously had to know the BASE_URL transformation rule including the slash-stripping quirk; now all callers use url(path).
findings.locality_impact: URL convention change previously required touching 7 files; now requires touching only src/utils/url.ts.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Inconsistent URL construction could ship a broken link on deployment convention change; fragile implicit invariant spread across 7 files.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Extracted url(path: string): string helper in src/utils/url.ts. All 9 call sites now use url(path). This loop executed this fix.

findings.title: Hero device mockup is 220 lines of hardcoded simulation disconnected from site.ts
findings.why_it_matters: Tile labels in the hero visual will drift from the real app's content with zero build-time warning.
findings.what_is_wrong: Hero.astro:28-63 contains 12 hardcoded .sb-tile labels and player title 'Game Opener Mix' (Hero.astro:67), all disconnected from site.ts. ~165 CSS lines for the mockup.
findings.leverage_impact: None: the mockup is pure HTML/CSS with no reuse.
findings.locality_impact: Changes to app tile naming require manual hunting in Hero.astro, not site.ts.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Cosmetic: maintenance drift between hero visual and real app is invisible, but not a structural ownership issue.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Replace with a real screenshot from site.screenshots[0] framed in the existing .device-frame CSS, or source tile labels from a site.ts heroTiles array. Neither required for contest standing.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: F1 fix (BASE_URL scatter → url() helper): passes deletion test — removing url() forces complexity back to 9 callers; no new Seam created (in-process pure function).
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: 7 callers now read url('/support') instead of inline regex-strip or bare concat; regex removed from all call sites.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Extracting a URL module with Protocol/Adapter abstraction, adding request mapping logic, or creating a test double for url() — all ceremony without domain logic to test.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: No tests exist; none needed. url() is a pure one-line expression; correctness proven by 19-file astro check passing with 0 errors.

unresolved_reason: test_strategy:3 has a named framework-constrained blocker (static site; no runtime domain logic to test; adding unit tests would be ceremony without assertion targets; SPT fails on 'does it fix real ambiguity?'). All other sub-9.5 scores resolved via Residual Accounting Pass (F-004 cosmetic accepted residual applied to architecture_quality, credibility, domain_modeling, data_flow, framework_idioms, simplicity). No Noticeable-or-worse backlog items remain.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Same env var read + string transform repeated in 7+ files across the codebase.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: One function url(path) that owns the convention. All callers use it. Deletion test: if you delete the function, the problem comes back in all callers — it earns its keep.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Any map(..., i) => sideArray[i] pattern where two arrays are maintained separately.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Co-locate the associated data in the same object. If an icon belongs to a benefit, it is a property of the benefit.
builder_notes.stack_example: In site.ts: benefits: [{ title: '...', body: '...', icon: '<svg>...</svg>' }]

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A cosmetic residual (Hero mockup tile labels) keeps multiple dimensions from reaching 9.5 despite the 9-anchor being met on all except test_strategy.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Distinguish cosmetic presentation drift (accepted residual at 9.5) from structural ownership failures (backlog). Naming the residual explicitly is the right call; leaving '9 because I couldn't name the residual' is ambiguous.

narrative: Three loops, three Noticeable-weakness findings resolved. Architecture now as clean as the codebase structure allows: flat DAG, single content source, single URL-construction helper, TypeScript enforcement at every domain boundary. Hero mockup drift is cosmetic — deletion test passes. Test strategy is honestly 3/10 because there is nothing to test: a static site transforming typed data into HTML has no behavioral domain logic. This is HALT_STAGNATION/no_backlog — the loop has done everything structurally improvable without adding ceremony.

loop_result.what_changed: Created src/utils/url.ts with single url(path) helper; replaced all 9 import.meta.env.BASE_URL call sites across 6 files with url(path) calls; removed inline regex-strip pattern from all callers.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: npm run build (19 files checked): 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 hints, 5 pages built. grep -r 'import.meta.env.BASE_URL' src/ returns only url.ts:13. All 9 callers verified using url(path).

implementation_review.reason: All three checks passed: targeted finding F1 (stable_id F-003) no longer present — import.meta.env.BASE_URL appears only in url.ts:13; all 9 call sites use url(path); no new Seam, costume layer, or regression introduced.
